objects.name: Orion Nebula
objects.credit: NASA, ESA, M. Robberto (STScI) and the Hubble Space Telescope Orion Treasury Project Team
objects.note: The nearest large star-forming region, a nursery of newborn suns.

objects.name: Southern Ring Nebula
objects.note: A dying star's exhaled shells of gas, imaged by Webb.

objects.name: Pillars of Creation
objects.note: Towers of cold gas and dust where new stars are forming.

objects.name: Crab Nebula
objects.credit: NASA, ESA, J. Hester and A. Loll (Arizona State University)
objects.note: The wreck of a supernova that Earth saw explode in 1054 AD.

objects.name: Cosmic Cliffs
objects.note: The edge of a stellar nursery in Carina, carved by young stars.

objects.name: Andromeda Galaxy
objects.note: The nearest large galaxy, and where the Milky Way is headed.

objects.name: Whirlpool Galaxy
objects.credit: NASA, ESA, S. Beckwith (STScI) and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
objects.note: A grand-design spiral caught mid-collision with a smaller galaxy.

objects.name: Sombrero Galaxy
objects.credit: NASA, ESA and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
objects.note: A galaxy seen nearly edge-on, ringed by a dark lane of dust.

objects.name: Hubble eXtreme Deep Field
objects.credit: NASA, ESA, G. Illingworth, D. Magee, P. Oesch (UC Santa Cruz), R. Bouwens (Leiden), the HUDF09 Team
objects.note: Thousands of galaxies in one dark patch of sky, the farthest almost as old as the universe.
